what: Snake up tilt (AttackHi3) donor material for Pyra c06/c07 (G&W replacing Pyra), replacing G&W's own up tilt

source.plugin: libarc_network.nro on the SD, Smash running, port 43022
source.note: The console was on and reachable (ping OK, 43022 open) when this ran, so these came off the live game rather than waiting for the next dump.

why_live: dumps/arc holds only the thirteen grenade special_n clips under fighter/snake/motion/body/c00 (not c02attackhi3), no snake body skeleton and no snake voice bank; the ARC index lists all of them.

CORRECTED 2026-10-02: that path no longer exists in this workspace - see `corrections` below and `handbook/graveyard.md` R-SNAKE-UPTILT-1. The text now lives in `donor_acmd/`.
not_fetched_because_already_pinned.se_snake_c00_bank: refs/snake_grenade/arc/sound/bank/fighter/se_snake_c00.* (ninth tones already merged into the eflame banks for neutral-B)
not_fetched_because_already_pinned.params: dumps/arc/fighter/snake/param/vl.prc and expression_vl.prc - measured to contain no attack_hi3 entry, so the move is inline + motion-list only

not_needed.effects: AttackHi3 spawns only sys_attack_arc_b and sys_turn_smoke, which are common-bank effects; effect/fighter/snake/ef_snake.eff was therefore not pulled
not_needed.articles: no article and no work id is written by the move
not_needed.custom_status: AttackHi3 is a vanilla status kind; no new status id is allocated (contrast Snake neutral-B, which owns 0x1FB..0x207)
not_needed.donor_hitbox_bones: the script writes top/kneel/legl; eflame's built skeleton names LegL/KneeL and has no top bone. G&W's own up tilt, which runs on c06/c07 today, also writes top, so this is the working convention, not a defect to remap

measurements: refs/snake_attack_hi3/inventory.json, produced by tools/audit_snake_hi3_donor.py (tier B): raw attack_hi3 entry (cancel 38, flags 0x84, blend 0, game_script 0xef3bca119, anim 0x138caf3e29 = c02attackhi3), clip groups Transform 87 / Visibility 26 / Material 2, 77 of 87 transform nodes present on the built recipient with no case-only matches, 10 dropped (FaceN and the nine S_Bandanna nodes), both donor sound names resolving in pinned material and neither yet merged into the eflame banks in builds/pgwr/0.20.15.
hashes: per-file sha256 in extraction.json; re-verify with tools/fetch_arc_files.py --set snake_attack_hi3 --check
not_established: Anything about how the move looks or feels on G&W's body. Node coverage and name resolution are offline; that is tier D until a console run.
